_comment: M11's pre-registration: SPEC/11's claim, its pinned values, its five falsifiers and its validity checks, as data. Committed in M11 PR 2 AFTER `readers.txt`, which shows every reader named here emitting a value on synthetic fixtures (CLAUDE.md, Milestone discipline; ADR-080 decision 1). Proposed in SPEC/11 at PR 1. `tests/test_drill_pins.py` holds this file equal to SPEC/11's pinned table and to `drill/scenarios/caption-check.json`. Nothing here may change after it is committed (SPEC/11, What must not happen). On AI Quality plus Platform Engineering.
claim: For event jefferson-derby at tier 3, a seeded caption failure makes `pave drill` write a NO-GO. The NO-GO names the seeded gap, the pinned owner, and a fix-by time set by the pinned window, under a signature that refuses a hand edit. The delta drill run without the fix still writes NO-GO for the same gap. The delta drill run with the fix writes GO.

falsifiers.name: the seed is not caught
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not NO-GO, or the findings are anything other than exactly the seeded finding

falsifiers.name: the NO-GO names the wrong owner or time
falsifiers.false_if: owner.seat, owner.oncall or fix_window_s differs from its pin on either run

falsifiers.name: a hand edit survives
falsifiers.false_if: any edited copy of the seeded artifact for which verify does not exit 1 printing `signature: MISMATCH`

liveness.why_not_evidence: one key and one canonical form make it true by construction

edits.made_with: sed, one substitution on a copy
sed, one substitution on a copy
sed, one substitution on a copy

falsifiers.plant_live: cmp shows each copy differs from the seeded artifact

falsifiers.name: the control is not NO-GO for the same gap
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not NO-GO, or its finding lines differ from the seeded run's

falsifiers.name: the fix does not yield GO
falsifiers.false_if: decision is not GO, or any finding line

validity._comment: Read before any falsifier. A run failing one is INVALID: the claim is NOT MEASURED, M11 closes RED, and no run is repeated. B is PR 3's branch point on main; S, C and F are the commit fields of the seeded, control and fixed artifacts; R1 is the seeded artifact's path.

all.check: S, C and F lie in that order on PR 3's branch

seeded.check: git diff --name-only B S is exactly the fixture

control.check: git diff --name-only S C lies under milestones/M11/

fixed.check: git diff --name-only C F, minus milestones/M11/, is exactly the fixture
git diff B F -- drill/fixtures/jefferson-derby/captions.vtt is empty
